# ProTech Roofing

> Licensed residential and commercial roofing contractor serving Florida, Pennsylvania, North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, Connecticut, and Washington D.C. GAF Master Elite certified, 5.0-star rated on Google. Specializes in roof replacement, roof repair, storm damage restoration, and insurance claim support.

## About

- **Company**: ProTech Roofing LLC
- **Established**: September 2024
- **Headquarters**: St. Petersburg, FL
- **Service area**: 9 states + DC (FL, PA, NC, SC, VA, MD, DE, CT, DC)
- **Phone**: 1-866-308-2640
- **Email**: info@protechroof.net
- **Hours**: Mon–Fri 7 AM–6 PM, Sat 8 AM–2 PM (Eastern)
- **Certifications**: GAF Master Elite (top 2% of roofing contractors nationwide)
- **Reputation**: 5.0/5 on Google Reviews

## Services

- [Roof Replacement](https://protechroof.net/services/roof-replacement): Full tear-off and re-installation with GAF Timberline HDZ architectural shingles, lifetime workmanship warranty, 25-year manufacturer warranty.
- [Roof Repair](https://protechroof.net/services/roof-repair): Targeted repair for leaks, missing shingles, flashing failures, and storm damage.
- [Storm Damage Restoration](https://protechroof.net/services/storm-damage): Emergency tarping, hail and wind damage assessment, insurance claim documentation.
- [Insurance Claims Support](https://protechroof.net/services/insurance-claims): Help homeowners file and document roof insurance claims with adjusters.
- [Roof Inspection](https://protechroof.net/services/roof-inspection): Free satellite-measurement-based roof assessments.
- [Commercial Roofing](https://protechroof.net/services/commercial-roofing): Flat roof systems (TPO, EPDM, modified bitumen) for commercial properties.
- [Gutters & Siding](https://protechroof.net/services/gutters-siding): Companion services for full exterior protection.
